news_items.headline: Truist Securities upgrades RVMD, raises price target to $179 (+54.31%)
news_items.summary: Truist Securities assumed coverage with a Buy rating and raised the price target from $116 to $179, citing daraxonrasib clinical momentum.

news_items.headline: Revolution Medicines announces NEJM publication of daraxonrasib Phase 1/2 data in pancreatic cancer
news_items.summary: NEJM published Phase 1/2 daraxonrasib data supporting the rationale for the pivotal RASolute 302 Phase 3 trial in metastatic pancreatic cancer. Peer-reviewed validation of the lead asset.

news_items.headline: FDA grants expanded access for daraxonrasib; NDA submission planned
news_items.summary: FDA expanded access program for daraxonrasib granted on the back of positive Phase 3 RASolute 302 results; company guided to NDA submission. Regulatory progression catalyst.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Truist Securities raised PT to $179 on 2026-05-18. Prior wave Wedbush/Piper Sandler/Needham on 2026-05-07 post Phase 3 readout. Consensus 20 buy / 0 hold / 0 sell; high $263 / low $116.
